summary: Safe as a scored submit. It reuses the parent's judge-proven CUDA (16/16 tests, no fault) and changes only Python routing, with one hard per-band gate whose result is printed. The win is real but small: about -3 us on the weight-46 sliding decode_32 row, worth about +0.5% headline (not the +2% claimed). That is inside the ±1.5% CI, so judge the run on the decode_32 sliding row and the [sd-gate] B=32 lines, never on the headline.
justification: Mechanism is plausible and already measured. On the judge (job 118c6de9704146f3) the pair [pre-attn + sk TOK=1, ticket, grid p4=128] ran sliding decode_32 at 17.38 us shape (sk 13.9 + pre-attn 1.9 us kernels). Master's cluster C=4 runs it at 20.64 us shape (kernel 18.1 us) in cbd49dc94be548e7 and 20.40 us in restack-sk-pseudo-b1-cluster-c16-c4, so the expected row gain is about 1.17-1.19x. The floor is 3.3 us, so the pair (16.8 MB in a 13.9 us kernel, about 1.2 TB/s) is still about 5x off SoL; there is headroom but no physics problem. The other expected directions are consistent: decode_16 stays on Triton (parent's gate measured 1.006x < 1.05x), decode_1 is record-only (cluster C=16 kept), sliding verify keeps TOK=8 variants 4/5 (they constant-fold to master), and full rows are untouched. ERROR IN THE HYPOTHESIS: the '~+2% headline' figure is wrong. Master's decode_32 load is 46*20.64 + 16*227.88 = 4595 us. With 17.38 us it becomes 4446 us, which is 1.034x on one of six loads, so the geomean moves by 1.034^(1/6) = +0.55% (about 1.492 -> 1.500). That is inside the ±1.5% CI. WEAKEST LINK: the in-prepare 1.03x gate against cluster C=4. The parent's gate measured the pair at 19.3 us net (first pass) and 18.8 us (second pass), about 1.5-2 us above its judge shape time, because the gate charges the two-node boundary and launch differently from the judge. Cluster C=4 has never been timed in this gate harness. If it is inflated less than the pair (it is one node), the gate ratio may come in nearer 1.05-1.10x than the judge's 1.18x. It should still clear 1.03x. The risk is that it lands below 1.03x and the scored run silently measures master. A secondary weakness: the parent picks the best of 12 candidates from one noisy pass (winner's curse) and computes its ratio from that same pass. Routing on that against a thin 1.03x margin is biased toward routing.
confounders: restack-sk-pseudo-cluster-plus-v3-fused-preattn (master eb1b68b): its cluster C=4 is now the incumbent this route must beat at B=17..32. The parent only ever gated against Triton (25.4 us net), so the parent's 1.313x does not carry over. Expect about 1.1-1.2x against cluster.

restack-sk-pseudo-cluster-plus-v3-fused-preattn (FUSED_PRE skF gate): on master's own job the skF gate REJECTED FUSED_PRE at B=16 (0.996x) and B=32 (1.015x vs the 1.02x gate). The full decode rows on master therefore ran pre-attn + v2, not skF. The hypothesis's instruction to 'confirm full decode rows are not on the v2 fallback' is misinformed: v2 is master's normal outcome. B=32 sits 0.5% under its gate, so it can flip between runs and move full decode_32 (weight 16, 228 us) by about 1.5% with no connection to this change.

full decode_32 row noise (independent of any landed change): the same kernel measured 212.8 us in the parent's job and 227.9 us on master. That swing is about 3.3% of the decode_32 load, about 0.55% headline, the same size as this hypothesis's whole expected gain. The parent's 1.4973 headline was partly this noise.

restack-sk-pseudo-cluster-plus-v3-fused-preattn (sliding verify B=1 pseudo route, variants 4/5): it shares _ps_ticket/_ps_gticket and load_prefix_pseudo with the new TOK=1 variants 6/7. Templating must leave TOK=8 byte-identical, so print the regs/smem line for variants 4/5 and compare it with master's. A sliding verify_1 move would come from the template, not from the route.

fused-preattention-triton (landed): now runs as a separate node on sliding decode B=17..32 (PAIRED=False, ROPE on), and it alone must store the new K/V row before the sk window reads it. Stream order guarantees this, and the parent passed. The pre-attn node costs about 1.9 us on the profile and 3.8 us net in the gate, which is part of why the gate ratio is thinner than the kernel ratio.
interference: No companion is warranted, and none is affordable (0 attention checks today). Each sliding decode band runs either the routed pair, named in PATH CHOSEN with pair, cluster and Triton numbers, or byte-identical master code. A gain or a neutral result is therefore read directly from the decode_32 sliding row's top_kernels (splitkv_attn_sk_kernel<4,tru...> + _pre_attention_kernel vs sliding_cluster_kernel) and from the [sd-gate] B=32 lines. An ab-revert of the cluster restack would only re-measure the parent's run vs Triton, which already exists. The confounders that matter (full decode_32 noise, the skF gate flip) are headline-level. They are resolved by reading the rows and the skF PATH CHOSEN lines, not by another run.
rules_flags: None blocking. The kernel_fn change is a config-only lookup of a frozen MappingProxyType. There is no host sync, no allocation sized by input values, no try/except, and no per-call state. The CUDA is the parent's, which passed the judge's checks.

Coverage note, not a violation: none of the 16 tests reaches the new route. The only page-1 sliding decode test is batch 4, band 2..16, which stays on Triton. Correctness at B=17..32 therefore rests on the in-prepare fp32 self-check, the two-state replay check, and the judge's per-timed-call check. The final review reruns nearby shapes (e.g. B=20-32 at other contexts), which will take this route. Keep the parent's ragged/80000/2047/2049/kv 0.25 self-check cases intact.

Ticket safety: _sd_setup now runs AFTER master's finally:_rezero_tickets() block, so the master's safety net no longer covers it. The parent's own 'tickets not reset -> drop every band' check runs only when choice is non-empty. Run the ticket-sum check (or _rezero_tickets()) unconditionally at the end of _sd_setup, including when no band routes, so the B=1/B=16 gate launches cannot leave _ps_ticket dirty for master's sliding verify B=1 pseudo route.
